governance_note: Define observations, variables, measurements, units, weights, and missing-data handling.
Document centering, scaling, normalization, transformations, filtering, and weighting.
State whether extraction uses SVD, PCA, factor models, NMF, ICA, embeddings, or another method.
Report retained rank, component count, factor count, latent dimension, and sensitivity tests.
Explain why retained components are treated as signal.
Report reconstruction error, residual norms, anomaly scores, and localized residual patterns.
Validate across preprocessing, samples, time windows, subgroups, rank choices, and seeds.
Treat latent components as inferred model artifacts, not causes, categories, proxies, or complete truths.
